distinguishing_feature: [LLM DRAFT] Presence of resting tremor, rigidity, and bradykinesia accompanied by motor fluctuations.
[LLM DRAFT] Prominent orthostatic hypotension, anhidrosis, or gastrointestinal dysmotility without central motor signs.
[LLM DRAFT] Episodic loss of balance without prominent systemic autonomic failure symptoms such as anhidrosis or orthostatic hypotension.
[LLM DRAFT] Presence of central dopaminergic motor features like resting tremor, rigidity, and bradykinesia accompanying the autonomic symptoms.
[LLM DRAFT] Early, frequent falls within the first year of symptom onset suggest atypical parkinsonism rather than Parkinson's disease.
[LLM DRAFT] Prominent early autonomic failure without central motor signs points toward a peripheral autonomic disorder rather than Parkinson's disease.
